_comment: Connection & Agent list messages — Controller <-> Gateway

list_agents._desc: Controller asks Gateway for the current list of agents

e2ee_init._desc: Controller initiates ECDH Key Exchange. Target agent will verify PIN and reply with e2ee_ready.

e2ee_payload._desc: Controller sends encrypted command wrapped in e2ee_payload. Gateway acts as blind relay.

agents_list._desc: Gateway replies with all known agents and their online status

agent_status._desc: Gateway pushes a status change when an agent goes online or offline

permissions_reset._desc: Gateway/Agent pushes this after reconnecting to instruct Controller to drop session keys and revoke permissions.

e2ee_ready._desc: Agent replies to e2ee_init after deriving session key.

e2ee_payload._desc: Agent sends encrypted response wrapped in e2ee_payload. Gateway acts as blind relay.
